question: Does the "Shikawa Shinju" ("Double Suicide at Death River") tattoo on Aramaki's chest refer to 's song "Shinjuku Shinju" ("Double Suicide in Shinjuku")?
answer: He does have a song with that title, but no. As a matter of fact, there is a classic story called "Double Suicide in Shinagawa", which is what I was paying homage to. Double suicides are often of ill-fated lovers, and Aramaki seems to have some tragic background revolving around women. It would seem this tattoo refers to that.
name: Morley
